segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Good morning, Synmouth Museum. Can I help you?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh yes. Good morning. I'm interested in the children's workshops and I'd like a little more information, please.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do you mean the Art and Craft workshops?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes. A friend of a friend mentioned them- the children do painting and make models and so forth.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, of course. Urn, where to begin? First of all, as you probably know, they run every Saturday.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Fine. And what about ages?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, all ages from five upwards are welcome, though we do ask that children below cigh1 years of age are accompanied by an adult.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Fine. That wouldn't be a problem. What about cost?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, I think you'll find them very reasonable. It's £2.50 a child, with 80 pence off for two or more children from the same family.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh yes, very reasonable. And are they held in the main museum?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Not exactly. They're nearby.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Could you give me the full address? I don't know the area very well.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, it's Winter House.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And that's in Tamer Street.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Could you spell that please?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, T-A-M- E- R Street.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Lovely.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And I do need to tell you that there's a security entrance, so you need to press the green button for someone to let you in. Don't press the red button please, but don't worry, it's all clearly labelled.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK. And one more question- is parking available nearby? We're driving in from out of town.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Your best bet is to leave your car at the back of the~- on a Saturday morning there are plenty of spaces there. It's right next door to the museum.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And can I ask about booking places?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, and I must tell you, you really should book by calling the education department here.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, I'm sorry, should I h~ve rung them instead of the main museum number?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: No, that's fine this time, please don't worry. But for future reference, I'll give you the direct number. It's two hundred-seven-six-five.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Great, I've got that.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: But I'm very happy to give you information about the next two workshops. On Saturday the 16th there's Building ~-

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, sounds great!

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: This involves quite a bit of glue, so just make sure the kids are in .cld clothes.

segments.speaker: W.OMAN
segments.en: I know, ones I don't mind getting mucky.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Exactly. And if possible, could you bring along bottle tops which the children might be able to use in the models, you know, as decoration?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We'll certainly try to find some for you.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Then the following week . ..

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That'll be the 23rd, won't it?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, that's right. On that day, it's what we call Undersea Worlds. This is where they make scenes with fishes, underground caverns and so on.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Is that likely to get very dirty? Lots of paint splashes?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Not really, ~owe don't recommend any special clothes for that one. But if you could search out some silver paper to bring along to use in the sessions, you know, it's shiny- it looks like water, that'd be great.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, of course. We'll see what we can come up with. Well, thank you ever so much for all your help. The sessions sound really good and I'll certainly book up for the next two.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Lovely. Thanks very much for ringing.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Bye.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Bye-bye.
